name: Walking staff
description: Staff-high and shod in iron. Equally useful on a muddy hill or on a man who has left the hill too late.
notes: A quarterstaff-style walking staff; no moves of its own yet, like the ash staff. Catalogue tier common (economy doc, staves 60-140). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
